provenance: AI source-aware triage of exposed Chinese development cues and retained raw Russian drafts; no independent bilingual reviewer

case_reviews.assessment: The 9400 generation remains, but one incomplete source line changes from a product-oriented draft to an awkward production noun; no established meaning gain.

The revised 36-month phrase moves the anchor from an imaginary earliest stage to before development, but does not clearly attach the 36-month lead to joint planning. Do not count a confirmed relation repair.
The rejected draft's financial-investment wording remains even though the following cue specifies a jointly committed development team of more than one thousand people.

The revision moves 11–12 at night into preceding cue 327, whose Chinese text supplies no such number, and replaces cue 328's one-or-two-in-the-morning statement with generic late-night work. This worsens the cross-cue time fact.

The revised text uses future tense rather than present availability, but switches to an owned 'we will have products' claim; the Chinese scene expresses expectation about the addressees' further cooperation bringing products to everyone. Full agency is unconfirmed.
The explicit first-generation 9400 fact remains. A neighboring thanks line drops 'everyone', a minor omission outside the protected primary fact.
The source explicitly says joint development starts 36 months after project start; this after-start relation remains.
Both ten million yuan and a one-thousand-person team remain in the Russian answer.
The explicitly stated 11–12 at night remains in the revision; do not force 1–2 in the morning here.
Explicit current availability remains rather than being forced into future hope.
